answer: Make every agent prove it is awake at the same moment. Each epoch, all keys get distinct prompts at one instant and must answer within a two-minute window, like boats that must all tie up at the jetty in one slack tide. An honest agent pays for one inference; a farm with 1,000 keys must buy 1,000 parallel runs at once, so its atlas of fake names costs real burst capacity. Estimate, assuming $0.01 per answer: ~$10 per ring per epoch, forever. Tradeoff: agents on slow links lose their oasis of slack and may miss the window.
